correctness.rationale: The selected lower-row minor invariant, determinant 2^(k-1), prospective pivot comparison 2 versus 2^(1-k), and explicit final-column residual prove that the first non-natural pivot fixes G at 2^j for every possible future tie history. Probability products then yield the complete law and mean. Exact rational exhaustive state enumeration (orders 2–9; 576 transitions) independently matches all atoms/tails; the proof, not enumeration, justifies all dimensions. n=2 and the final two-row exception are handled explicitly.

originality.rationale: The new claim is the complete finite-n probability law, survival function, exact expectation and factorial catastrophic tail of uniform maximum-magnitude tie breaking on the classical Wilkinson matrix. Higham–Higham (1989) classify full worst-case attainment, Shah–Urschel (2026) establish sparse and alternative randomized partial-pivot worst-case phenomena, and accessible numerical expositions compare deterministic tie policies and perturbed data. These prior claims do not directly state or logically imply the full uniform-tie law without the new post-deviation Schur/minor classification. Searches of mathematical records and public literature did not reveal an exact equivalent. Residual risk: classic textbook or unindexed equivalent may exist.
residual_risks: The research literature may contain unindexed formulations of the same finite Wilkinson tie law or an implicit equivalent in a general permutation enumeration.
The recent Gaussian-input growth paper was inspected only at abstract level; although its model is distinct, a related example in its full text is not excluded.
The precise exact-arithmetic uniform-tie policy differs from practical hardware default ties and infinitesimal additive noise.

value.rationale: A central example in numerical linear algebra changes from deterministic exponential growth to an exact distribution with factorial worst-case probability and mean tending to two under a natural unbiased tie-resolution rule. The result identifies the full risk profile, not merely one favorable row ordering or a known fact of generic smoothed stability; the role of conditional ties is mathematically and algorithmically motivated.
